blocks.text: 本包提供两条 Worker 接线：WorkerAdapter / createWorkerHandler 执行通用计算，workerComputed 把该请求接入 Resource；序列化子入口则把普通 parser 接入 Worker 和 SerializeRegistry。请求关联、provider、取消、deadline、来源与错误传输归 rpc-core，Resource 的缓存、重试和响应式生命周期归 resource，格式解析与注册表归 serialize。本包只拥有应用载荷转换、分段 credit / ACK 和这些 API 的接线，不创建另一套 RPC 引擎。

rows: WorkerAdapter、createWorkerHandler、workerComputed、IManagedRpcHandler、端口 / Resource 配置类型、所有权 / 诊断常量与错误。

blocks.text: reactive、resource、serialize、rpc-core、rpc-contract、utils 是运行时依赖。直接导入它们时，应用也应直接安装需要的包。根入口不导出序列化 factory，没有 serialize/* 通配入口；旧根 aliases 需迁移到精确子路径，没有兼容 shim。encodeWorkerValue / decodeWorkerValue 与 transferablesOf 是内部工具，不作为业务导出。无抛点的旧 CHUNK_MERGE_FAILED 已移除，当前保留六码。
该桥固定使用 exclusive 拓扑：一个逻辑连接对应一对端口，默认本端 main、对端 worker，经 connect 做 Core 的一致性检查和目录接线，不使用自定义 identifier。这不赋予任意共享 Worker 对象多客户端复用保证。一个 MessagePort 可以满足端口形状，但创建者仍须安排独立的物理连接和资源归属。

IWorkerPort 是 Core IWebWorkerLikePort 的别名，要求 postMessage、addEventListener、removeEventListener，消息事件为 message / error / messageerror。浏览器 Worker / MessagePort / 单条 SharedWorker.port 可提供这种面；Node 示例使用真实 Worker 内运行的 handler 与原生 MessagePort，不伪造端口。IWorkerLike 额外允许可选 terminate()；结构可传入不等于本包获得原生 Worker 的创建或退出所有权。
`new WorkerAdapter(port, options?)` 同步返回对象，内部 Endpoint 异步初始化；request 自动等初始化，不需要额外 ready API。

同一 Adapter 可并发 request；Core 按请求关联结果、隔离 deadline 与取消。独立请求可用 Promise.all，让支持 batch@1 的内建载体在物理写进行时合并已就绪请求或响应；空闲时立即单帧发送，有依赖的串行 await 不会因此变成批处理。request 等处理结果，内部 one-way notify 仅等物理发送，不是业务执行回执。

sections.heading: Worker 侧 handler 与输入载荷

blocks.text: `createWorkerHandler<Input, Output>(compute, postMessage, options?)` 验证两个必填函数，再建立消息处理器。compute(payload, { signal }) 可同步返回或返回 Promise；signal 是原生取消信号，长任务应配合检查或监听，框架不强制中断正在执行的同步代码。postMessage(message) 把 Core 消息交给真实父端口。options.timeoutMs 缺省 undefined，只影响该端点发起的 request，不为本端 compute 设置运行期限；请求期限通常由主端 Adapter 配置。

返回 IManagedRpcHandler 后，调用方要把真实 message.data 交给 handler。它不是自己安装全局 onmessage 的 Worker 创建器；浏览器可在监听器中交付数据，Node 使用 MessagePort 监听。handler 返回 Promise，初始化或交付路径失败仍应由宿主观察；普通 provider compute 抛错由 Core 转为失败响应，不能据此泛称所有宿主回调都永远不 reject。

桥会把业务输入转换为 portable 数据：支持普通记录 / 数组、有限基础值、undefined，以及 ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array 的显式字节表示。它不是任意原型、函数、Map / Set 或循环对象图的无损 structured clone；业务需要这些形状时先定义可传输表示或使用合适 parser。内部 $worker 标签为保留表示，不能把相同标记形状当成普通业务对象，也不能用来宣称信任。

blocks.text: 初始化期间已经接纳的消息在 close 后也不再交付，pendingCount 最终回到 0。不要把该计数当成安全 terminate 的静默门禁；端点 provider drain 和清理由 Core 契约负责，应等待 dispose 并按物理资源 owner 规则处理 Worker。此接口没有 disposeAsync。序列化 handler 也只释放自己的 Endpoint / provider 注册，不自动调用借入 parser.dispose，parser 生命周期仍归创建者。

`workerComputed(adapter, selectInput, options?)` 返回标准 `Resource<Output>`。每次 Resource fetcher 同步调用 selectInput 一次，再以该输入请求 Adapter，并转发 Resource signal 和可选 transfer(input)。同步读取的 signal / computed 依赖由 Resource 追踪；await 后才读取的值不自动归入这次同步依赖。它不提供跨 Resource 或跨 Worker 的全局缓存 / 请求去重。

sections.heading: 序列化 parser 与插件

blocks.text: workerParser(options) 是主端 ISerializeParser；workerPlugin(options) 只是把它的 name / parser 组合成标准 ISerializePlugin，供 createSerializeRegistry 使用。两者仅从 /serialize/worker 导入。

rows: worker，格式标签，必须与真实 Worker parser 的编码含义相符；读存档时用正确标签。
copy；另一个值为 transfer，见字节规则。

blocks.text: options 的这五个字段在入口各读一次；非对象、反射或读取失败、非法字段值以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。parser 无 timeoutMs 选项，不能建议配置不存在的 parser.timeoutMs；取消使用 SerializeContext.signal，注册表另有自己的生命周期预算。

encode(value, context) 将 Uint8Array 输入分类为 bytes，其他为 value，返回按块消费的异步序列；不是同步返回一份合并好的 chunk。decode(chunk, context) 请求 Worker 解码，返回结果段的 payload，不再给调用方多包一层 chunk。context 提供 signal 和用于诊断的 context 名称；注册表会传入其真实上下文。

workerParser.dispose 异步退休活跃输出并关闭 Endpoint，默认不终止原生 Worker；terminateOnDispose 为 true 时，即便端点清理失败也继续尝试调用可选 terminate。只有同步 terminate 调用抛错才由这段捕获，不宣称等待原生异步退出。端点单独失败保留 RpcLifecycleError 清理信息，terminate 单独抛错保留原错，两者均失败才生成 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 按端点、terminate 顺序保留。重复 parser.dispose 返回同一个 Promise。Registry.dispose 需要 await 才能观察其异步清理结果。

sections.heading: Worker 侧序列化与分段流

blocks.text: createSerializeWorkerHandler(parser, post) 的两个参数必填：真实 parser 必须提供 encode / decode，post(message, transfer?) 委托真实 Worker 端口。非对象 / 非函数在 Endpoint 创建前同步拒绝。parser 成员 getter 抛错时，可注记未归属原生 Error 保留同一对象、类型和 stack 并附 INVALID_OPTION；完整外包 source/code 保留，不可注记值通过 cause 或聚合链保留。

handler 传 parser.encode 输入段的 payload；输出可为一个合法 ISerializeChunk，或同步 / 异步 chunk iterable。主端以 open / chunk / end 帧增量接收，初始两个 credit、按顺序 ACK，消费后补 credit；不调用 collectStream 或先把所有结果拼为一份。credit 限制单流发送进度，不是全 Worker 的总字节上限，producer 可先取得下一块再等待发送 credit。

返回的合法 text / bytes / value 段保持顺序，可有空流和混合段；删掉的 CHUNK_MERGE_FAILED 不再承担这种路径。parser.decode 接收原 chunk，解码结果是 Uint8Array 则分类为 bytes，否则为 value。Worker 侧向外发送的完整 bytes backing 可按其发送规则转移，不由主端输入 ownership 自动赋予输出重用保证。

消费者提前结束或取消会通知对应 stream，唤醒等待 credit 的 producer，并尝试 iterator.return；清理又失败时用既有 secondary-error 附加保留主错与次错。终结错误通过 Core RPC rejection 传 source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors 链，不另造普通 error 应用帧。实际不可合作的业务代码仍须由应用负责，不把流取消宣称为强制停止 Worker。

sections.id: 字节复制-转移与实际载荷
sections.heading: 字节复制、转移与实际载荷

blocks.text: WorkerByteOwnership 是公开词表 copy / transfer，IByteOwnership 是其值联合；WorkerDiagnosticType 只有 worker，IWorkerDiagnosticType 是该值类型。它们不接收参数。默认 copy 保留调用方输入；transfer 是显式放弃独占输入存储的策略。

序列化输入只有 bytes 段、真实 Uint8Array、且视图覆盖整个普通 ArrayBuffer（offset 为 0、length 等于 backing 长度）才进入 transfer list。局部 subarray、SharedArrayBuffer backing 等不满足条件时回退复制；普通 ArrayBuffer 的其他别名不会被检测并排除转移，整块转移可能同时使它们失效。共享 backing 不因此变成一个支持的共享内存计算协议。顶层非 bytes 的 text / value 不因 ownership 自动转移内部对象。
实际原生 post 提交后，转移可能让整个 backing 及所有别名 view detach；预取消尚未发送时输入仍可用，不能看到 transfer 选项或取消码就断言数据已丢失。重试前检查实际 buffer 状态，或选择 copy / 保留应用副本。transferablesOf / exclusiveBuffer 是内部工具，不作为公开 API 调用。
当前 portable 桥先把 bytes 转成 base64url 载荷，再独立传 native transfer list，因此 detach 不证明载荷零拷贝。小计算与复杂对象图还要承担编码和往返成本；旧实现耗时与倍率不代表当前实现，没有本轮性能数字或速度保证。应用应按真实工作量判断是否值得卸载，而不是从“用了 Worker”推导提速。

通用 Adapter request 保留 canonical Core 取消、超时、transport 与远程错误。compute 异常通常在 RpcRemoteError / INTERNAL 外层之下恢复原生 TypeError / RangeError 等 cause、message 和 stack；不要要求接收对象与 Worker 原对象 identity 相同，也不要把所有顶层异常当成业务原生类型。未配置期限且 provider 一直不结算时，请求仍可能等待；不能承诺任何坏 Worker 都必然及时 settle。

序列化 decode / request 与预取消 encode 使用 SerializeCodecError / REQUEST_ABORTED，包含 type（默认 worker）、phase（encode / decode）、context、chunkIndex 0 和 bytesConsumed（输入 bytes 长度，否则 0），原 signal.reason 保留在 cause。活动 encode 流可以由原始 RPC / 取消失败终结，不保证每个失败都有全部 codec 字段。credit 等待和显式流停止创建原生 DOMException / AbortError，message 为 serialize stream cancelled，附 REQUEST_ABORTED；其原生类型、message 和 stack 由错误链保留。

blocks.text: 把每个示例分别保存为一个独立的 ESM TypeScript 文件，再用 Node 24 执行该文件；不要在交互式标准输入中运行，因为 Worker 会通过 import.meta.url 重新加载同一文件。子线程只接收转移给它的原生端口；父线程负责 finally 中的关闭与终止。无需浏览器端口替身或额外 Worker 包装层。
一项计算需要离开界面线程，调用方又不想自己维护消息标识与响应匹配。
只发送业务数据，还需要手写请求匹配、启动就绪和失败处理；主线程的等待也容易与 Worker 初始化错开。
创建真实 Node Worker，把 `MessagePort` 转交给它，再配对 `WorkerAdapter` 与 `createWorkerHandler`；`request` 自动等待端点初始化，返回的进程与线程标识可核对计算位置。

`new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url), { workerData: port2, transferList: [port2] })` 在另一个线程执行当前文件；`isMainThread` 区分两条分支，`workerData` 是交给子线程的端口，`transferList` 转移的是端口而非业务输入。`port1.start()` 启用原生端口的事件分发。`request` 的两个泛型只声明输入与返回值类型；本例载荷为 `[20, 22]`，未设置 `signal` 或业务转移列表。适配器的 `clientId` 默认 `'main'`，`timeoutMs` 默认 `undefined`，不设期限。
输出：

blocks.code: 结果： 42 true true

blocks.text: 输出 `结果： 42 true true`：结果是 `42`，Worker 与父线程位于同一进程，却使用不同线程。
这里验证的是 Node 24 原生 Worker，不是浏览器环境或进程隔离；`clientId` 默认 `'main'`，`timeoutMs` 默认 `undefined`。端口由适配器借用，调用方仍需关闭端口并终止自己创建的 Worker。

sections.id: 停止请求并保留借用的-worker
sections.heading: 停止请求并保留借用的 Worker

blocks.text: 页面关闭了请求客户端，应用却仍持有 Worker 和端口。
在客户端清理时直接终止 Worker，会释放不属于它的资源；只标记关闭，又会留下端点订阅。
用 `close` 立即拒绝新请求，再等待 `dispose` 释放端点；重复销毁复用同一个 Promise，最后用原生消息确认借用的 Worker 端口仍能通信。
`close()` 与 `dispose()` 都无参数；前者同步退休请求入口，后者异步释放端点，重复调用复用 Promise。示例最后通过 `port1.once` 与原生 `'ping'` / `'pong'` 验证借用端口仍可用；它们不是本包业务协议。`Worker` 与端口由本例创建，因此仍由 `finally` 关闭和终止。
输出：

blocks.code:
关闭前： 42
已关闭： true ADAPTER_DISPOSED
同一清理： true
借用端口： pong

blocks.text: 依次输出 `关闭前： 42`、`已关闭： true ADAPTER_DISPOSED`、`同一清理： true`、`借用端口： pong`。
`close` 只停止接收新请求，`dispose` 才执行可能失败的异步端点清理；两者都不关闭原生端口或终止 Worker。最后的探测是独立宿主消息，不是 RPC 请求。

sections.id: 保留-worker-计算失败的原因链
sections.heading: 保留 Worker 计算失败的原因链

blocks.text: Worker 中的计算因输入问题抛出 `TypeError`，其原因又是一个 `RangeError`，调用方需要同时看到两层失败。
只回传错误消息，会在线程边界丢失原生类型、嵌套原因和原始堆栈信息。
用 `createWorkerHandler` 包装真实计算，并向它转交收到的消息；RPC 返回远端失败，其原因链保留原生 `TypeError` 与内部 `RangeError`，无需另建错误消息协议。
`createWorkerHandler(compute, postMessage)` 的两个函数均必填；本例 `compute` 抛出含 `cause` 的原生 `TypeError`，`postMessage` 委托原生端口。主端没有设置超时，默认不设期限；错误由跨线程 RPC 原因链读取，不要求接收对象与子线程原对象相同。消息监听器观察 handler 返回 Promise 的投递失败。
输出：

blocks.code:
远端错误： RpcRemoteError INTERNAL
原始错误： true 无法计算总数
原因： true 行数据无效
堆栈： true true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `远端错误： RpcRemoteError INTERNAL`、`原始错误： true 无法计算总数`、`原因： true 行数据无效`、`堆栈： true true`。
外层错误属于 RPC Core，原生错误保留在 `cause` 链中，不会把最外层变成 `TypeError`。消息处理器的 Promise 只等待投递，不代表计算完成；操作结果由主端请求等待。

sections.heading: 用 Resource 管理 Worker 结果与缓存

blocks.text: 界面需要展示加载与成功状态，也需要缓存 Worker 结果，输入之后还可能继续变化。
在请求旁再维护结果变量和缓存，会重复实现 `Resource` 的行为，也容易把旧输入的结果留在界面上。
用 `workerComputed` 同步选择输入，并传入信号所属的运行时；`autoStart: false` 跳过构造时主动启动，读取 `state` 仍可按需取值，再等待 `refetch`、读取缓存并在输入改变后刷新。

`runtime` 显式使用输入信号所属的运行时；省略时为 `defaultRuntime`。`selectInput` 同步返回 `values.value`；`autoStart: false` 覆盖默认 `true`，只跳过构造时主动启动，首个 `state` 读取仍会触发请求。`ttl` 默认 `Infinity`，本例不覆盖；`refetch()` 强制取值，`promise` 被动读取可复用新鲜缓存。`Resource` 借用适配器，须先释放资源，再清理端点与原生 Worker。
输出：

blocks.code:
取值前： pending
首次： 6 success
缓存： true 6
更新： 9 success

blocks.text: 依次输出 `取值前： pending`、`首次： 6 success`、`缓存： true 6`、`更新： 9 success`。
`autoStart` 默认 `true`，设为 `false` 只跳过构造时主动启动；首次读取 `state` 会按需取值并显示 `pending`。`ttl` 默认 `Infinity`，被动读取 `promise` 复用新鲜缓存，`refetch` 则强制刷新；先释放资源，再清理借用的适配器与 Worker。

sections.id: 把现有-json-解析器接入-worker-注册表插件
sections.heading: 把现有 JSON 解析器接入 Worker 注册表插件

blocks.text: 应用已经使用序列化注册表，现在需要把某个解析器放到 Worker 执行。
把注册表调用改成临时消息，会重复实现格式选择与清理；主线程再运行一份解析器，又没有建立预期的执行边界。
在真实 Worker 中用 `createSerializeWorkerHandler` 接入 `jsonParser`，主线程注册 `workerPlugin`；继续调用注册表的编码与解码接口，由格式标签选择此插件。

`workerPlugin` 的 `worker` 必填，本例为原生端口；`type: 'json'` 覆盖默认 `'worker'`，只作为本地注册表格式标签，不改变 Worker 中 `jsonParser()` 的算法。`ownership` 默认 `'copy'`，`clientId` 默认 `'main'`，`terminateOnDispose` 默认 `false`。注册表借助插件进行 `encode` / `decode`，`registry.dispose()` 清理插件端点；本例仍负责原生端口和 Worker。
输出：

blocks.code:
数据块： text
恢复： report 2

blocks.text: 依次输出 `数据块： text`、`恢复： report 2`：工作端 JSON 解析器返回文本块，并恢复了原有字段。
显式 `type: 'json'` 覆盖默认 `'worker'`，`ownership` 默认 `'copy'`，`terminateOnDispose` 默认 `false`。注册表释放解析器端点，原生端口与 Worker 仍由调用方关闭；这里证明接线，不作速度结论。

sections.id: 取消解码时保留输入字节
sections.heading: 取消解码时保留输入字节

blocks.text: 输入字节可能还要留给下一次重试，当前解码却可能在发送前就不再需要。
转移共用的底层缓冲区可能让所有视图失效；把取消一律当成已经分离，也会丢弃根本没有发送的输入。
为真实 Worker JSON 解析器使用 `workerParser` 的默认复制策略，先完成一次解码，再传入预先中止的信号，检查失败原因和原字节后决定是否重试。

`workerParser({ worker: port1 })` 使用默认 `type: 'worker'`、`ownership: 'copy'`、`clientId: 'main'` 和 `terminateOnDispose: false`。`decode` 接收 `['bytes', bytes]` 与上下文；`signal` 控制此次调用，`context: 'settings'` 为诊断名称。第二次调用前已取消，原始 `DOMException` 保留在 `cause`，输入未被发送或分离；这不证明在途计算能够被强制中断。
输出：
依次输出 `解码： 2 11`、`已取消： REQUEST_ABORTED true`、`输入： {"count":2}`。
默认所有权策略为 `'copy'`；本次预取消保留调用方的原始原因且不发送工作，不证明已经运行的计算会被抢占中断。显式转移和字节分离同样不代表载荷实现了零拷贝。

本包提供两条 Worker 接线：WorkerAdapter / createWorkerHandler 执行通用计算，workerComputed 把该请求接入 Resource；序列化子入口则把普通 parser 接入 Worker 和 SerializeRegistry。请求关联、provider、取消、deadline、来源与错误传输归 rpc-core，Resource 的缓存、重试和响应式生命周期归 resource，格式解析与注册表归 serialize。本包只拥有应用载荷转换、分段 credit / ACK 和这些 API 的接线，不创建另一套 RPC 引擎。

rows: WorkerAdapter、createWorkerHandler、workerComputed、IManagedRpcHandler、端口 / Resource 配置类型、所有权 / 诊断常量与错误。

sections.heading: Worker 侧 handler 与输入载荷

blocks.text: `createWorkerHandler<Input, Output>(compute, postMessage, options?)` 验证两个必填函数，再建立消息处理器。compute(payload, { signal }) 可同步返回或返回 Promise；signal 是原生取消信号，长任务应配合检查或监听，框架不强制中断正在执行的同步代码。postMessage(message) 把 Core 消息交给真实父端口。options.timeoutMs 缺省 undefined，只影响该端点发起的 request，不为本端 compute 设置运行期限；请求期限通常由主端 Adapter 配置。

返回 IManagedRpcHandler 后，调用方要把真实 message.data 交给 handler。它不是自己安装全局 onmessage 的 Worker 创建器；浏览器可在监听器中交付数据，Node 使用 MessagePort 监听。handler 返回 Promise，初始化或交付路径失败仍应由宿主观察；普通 provider compute 抛错由 Core 转为失败响应，不能据此泛称所有宿主回调都永远不 reject。

桥会把业务输入转换为 portable 数据：支持普通记录 / 数组、有限基础值、undefined，以及 ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array 的显式字节表示。它不是任意原型、函数、Map / Set 或循环对象图的无损 structured clone；业务需要这些形状时先定义可传输表示或使用合适 parser。内部 $worker 标签为保留表示，不能把相同标记形状当成普通业务对象，也不能用来宣称信任。

sections.heading: 序列化 parser 与插件

blocks.text: workerParser(options) 是主端 ISerializeParser；workerPlugin(options) 只是把它的 name / parser 组合成标准 ISerializePlugin，供 createSerializeRegistry 使用。两者仅从 /serialize/worker 导入。

rows: worker，格式标签，必须与真实 Worker parser 的编码含义相符；读存档时用正确标签。
copy；另一个值为 transfer，见字节规则。

blocks.text: options 的这五个字段在入口各读一次；非对象、反射或读取失败、非法字段值以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。parser 无 timeoutMs 选项，不能建议配置不存在的 parser.timeoutMs；取消使用 SerializeContext.signal，注册表另有自己的生命周期预算。

encode(value, context) 将 Uint8Array 输入分类为 bytes，其他为 value，返回按块消费的异步序列；不是同步返回一份合并好的 chunk。decode(chunk, context) 请求 Worker 解码，返回结果段的 payload，不再给调用方多包一层 chunk。context 提供 signal 和用于诊断的 context 名称；注册表会传入其真实上下文。

workerParser.dispose 异步退休活跃输出并关闭 Endpoint，默认不终止原生 Worker；terminateOnDispose 为 true 时，即便端点清理失败也继续尝试调用可选 terminate。只有同步 terminate 调用抛错才由这段捕获，不宣称等待原生异步退出。端点单独失败保留 RpcLifecycleError 清理信息，terminate 单独抛错保留原错，两者均失败才生成 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 按端点、terminate 顺序保留。重复 parser.dispose 返回同一个 Promise。Registry.dispose 需要 await 才能观察其异步清理结果。

sections.heading: Worker 侧序列化与分段流

blocks.text: createSerializeWorkerHandler(parser, post) 的两个参数必填：真实 parser 必须提供 encode / decode，post(message, transfer?) 委托真实 Worker 端口。非对象 / 非函数在 Endpoint 创建前同步拒绝。parser 成员 getter 抛错时，可注记未归属原生 Error 保留同一对象、类型和 stack 并附 INVALID_OPTION；完整外包 source/code 保留，不可注记值通过 cause 或聚合链保留。

handler 传 parser.encode 输入段的 payload；输出可为一个合法 ISerializeChunk，或同步 / 异步 chunk iterable。主端以 open / chunk / end 帧增量接收，初始两个 credit、按顺序 ACK，消费后补 credit；不调用 collectStream 或先把所有结果拼为一份。credit 限制单流发送进度，不是全 Worker 的总字节上限，producer 可先取得下一块再等待发送 credit。

返回的合法 text / bytes / value 段保持顺序，可有空流和混合段；删掉的 CHUNK_MERGE_FAILED 不再承担这种路径。parser.decode 接收原 chunk，解码结果是 Uint8Array 则分类为 bytes，否则为 value。Worker 侧向外发送的完整 bytes backing 可按其发送规则转移，不由主端输入 ownership 自动赋予输出重用保证。

The bridge uses exclusive topology: one logical connection has one port pair, with main and worker as default identities. connect performs Core consistency checks and directory wiring without a custom identifier. This is not a guarantee of arbitrary multi-client sharing on one Worker object. A MessagePort can satisfy the port surface while its creator still owns physical connection setup and resources.

IWorkerPort aliases Core IWebWorkerLikePort, requiring postMessage, addEventListener, and removeEventListener for message / error / messageerror events. Browser Workers, MessagePorts, and an individual SharedWorker port can provide that surface. Node examples run handlers in real Workers through native MessagePorts rather than fabricated ports. IWorkerLike additionally permits terminate(); accepting this structure does not transfer Worker creation or native-exit ownership.

blocks.text: Adapter.dispose does not terminate the borrowed Worker or port. Cleanup failures reject rather than disappearing. Closing before readiness also prevents later initialization from dispatching retired requests. The creator terminates physical resources in application order; Endpoint cleanup is not a native thread exit receipt.

`createWorkerHandler<Input, Output>(compute, postMessage, options?)` validates its two required callbacks before creating the handler. compute(payload, { signal }) returns a result or Promise and receives native cancellation. Long work should check or observe that signal; the framework does not forcibly interrupt running synchronous code. postMessage(message) delegates Core messages to the real parent port. options.timeoutMs defaults to undefined and affects requests initiated by that Endpoint, not provider execution time; normally configure deadlines on the main Adapter.

Feed actual message.data to the returned IManagedRpcHandler. It does not create a Worker or install a global onmessage callback itself. Browser listeners deliver data; Node uses MessagePort delivery. Initialization or delivery failure can still reject the handler Promise and must be observed by its host. Ordinary compute exceptions become Core failure responses, which does not mean every host callback can never reject.

The bridge converts input to portable data: plain records / arrays, finite primitives, undefined, and explicit ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array byte representations. It does not transparently structured-clone arbitrary prototypes, functions, Maps / Sets, or cyclic graphs. Define a transferable representation or an appropriate parser for those shapes. Internal $worker tag shapes are reserved rather than ordinary application records or declarations of trust.

blocks.text: These five fields are read once at admission. Invalid option objects, reflection / property reads, or field values produce INVALID_OPTION. There is no parser.timeoutMs option. Use SerializeContext.signal for cancellation; registry lifecycle budgets remain separate.

encode(value, context) classifies Uint8Array input as bytes and other input as value, returning an asynchronous sequence of chunks rather than one merged result. decode(chunk, context) requests decoding and returns the result payload without another chunk wrapper. context carries signal and a diagnostic context name; the registry supplies its actual context.

workerParser.dispose retires active output and closes its Endpoint. By default it does not terminate the physical Worker. With terminateOnDispose true it still attempts optional terminate after Endpoint cleanup failure. This captures synchronous throws from terminate rather than awaiting native asynchronous exit. Endpoint-only failure retains RpcLifecycleError cleanup details; terminate-only failure retains that exception; both failures produce CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError with Endpoint then termination in errors. Repeated parser.dispose calls reuse one Promise. Await Registry.dispose to observe its async cleanup result.

createSerializeWorkerHandler(parser, post) requires a real parser with encode / decode and a post(message, transfer?) callback delegating to its actual port. Invalid shapes reject synchronously before Endpoint creation. An unowned extensible native error thrown by a parser-member getter stays the same object with native type / stack and gains INVALID_OPTION. Complete foreign source/code identities survive, and values that cannot be annotated remain reachable through cause or aggregation.

The handler passes the input chunk payload to parser.encode. Results may be one valid ISerializeChunk or a sync / async chunk iterable. The caller receives open / chunk / end incrementally, with two initial credits and ordered ACK; consumption restores credit. Neither collectStream nor whole-output merging is used. Credit bounds sending progress for one stream, not the whole Worker's byte budget; the producer may obtain its next chunk before waiting for sending credit.

Valid text / bytes / value chunks retain order, including empty and mixed streams. The removed CHUNK_MERGE_FAILED no longer handles that path. parser.decode receives its original chunk, and a Uint8Array result becomes bytes while other results become value. Eligible complete byte backing may transfer on Worker output according to that send path; caller input ownership does not grant reuse guarantees for producer output.

Early consumer completion or cancellation notifies that stream, wakes producers awaiting credit, and attempts iterator.return. If cleanup also fails, existing secondary-error attachment retains the primary and secondary chains. Core RPC rejection transports source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors rather than a separate application error frame. Uncooperative business code still requires application ownership; stream cancellation does not forcibly stop the Worker.

WorkerByteOwnership publicly defines copy / transfer and IByteOwnership is their union. WorkerDiagnosticType contains only worker, represented by IWorkerDiagnosticType. These constants take no arguments. Default copy preserves caller input, while transfer explicitly gives up exclusively owned storage.

Serializer input enters the transfer list only for bytes containing a genuine Uint8Array whose view spans one entire ordinary ArrayBuffer: offset zero and view length equal to backing length. Partial subarrays and SharedArrayBuffer-backed views fall back to copying. Other aliases of an eligible ordinary ArrayBuffer are not detected or excluded from transfer, so transferring that backing can detach them too. This does not provide a shared-memory computation protocol. Top-level text / value chunks do not recursively transfer their nested objects because of ownership alone.

A submitted native transfer may detach the full backing and all aliasing views. Pre-cancelled unsent input remains usable, so neither the option nor a cancellation code proves loss. Inspect actual backing before retrying, or use copy / retain an application copy. transferablesOf / exclusiveBuffer are internal rather than callable public APIs.

The current bridge base64url-encodes bytes as portable payload before separately passing a native transfer list. Detachment therefore does not prove zero-copy payload delivery. Small computations and object graphs still incur encoding and round trips. Old timings and ratios do not establish this implementation's behavior; no current timing or speed guarantee is made. Evaluate actual work instead of deriving speed from the presence of a Worker.

General Adapter requests retain canonical Core cancellation, timeout, transport, and remote identities. A compute failure commonly has RpcRemoteError / INTERNAL outside reconstructed native TypeError / RangeError causes with their messages and stacks. Do not expect sender-side object identity or require the top-level error itself to be the original native class. Without a deadline, a provider that never settles can leave a request pending; every broken Worker is not guaranteed to settle promptly.

Serialization decode / request and pre-cancelled encode use SerializeCodecError / REQUEST_ABORTED with type (default worker), phase encode / decode, context, chunkIndex 0, and bytesConsumed (input byte length or zero). The caller's signal.reason remains on cause. Active encode streams can end with the original RPC / cancellation error rather than every codec diagnostic field. Credit waits and explicit stream stop create native DOMException / AbortError with message serialize stream cancelled and REQUEST_ABORTED, preserving native type, message, and stack through the error chain.

sections.heading: Run a calculation in a real Worker

blocks.text: A large calculation needs to leave the UI thread without making callers manage message identifiers and response matching.
Posting application data alone leaves request matching, startup readiness and failure settlement to handwritten listeners.

Create a real Node Worker, transfer a MessagePort to it, and pair WorkerAdapter with createWorkerHandler. request waits for endpoint initialization; the returned PID and thread id show where the calculation ran.

`new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url), { workerData: port2, transferList: [port2] })` executes this file in another thread. `isMainThread` selects the branch, `workerData` carries the child port, and `transferList` transfers that port rather than application input. `port1.start()` enables native port event delivery. The two request type arguments describe input and output statically; the payload is `[20, 22]`, with no signal or application transfer list. Adapter defaults are `clientId: 'main'` and `timeoutMs: undefined`, meaning no deadline.
Output:

blocks.code: result: 42 true true

blocks.text: The output is `result: 42 true true`: the result is 42, the Worker shares the parent's process, and it runs on a different thread.

This is Node 24 native Worker execution, not a browser or process-isolation test. clientId defaults to 'main' and timeoutMs to undefined; the caller must close its borrowed port and terminate its own Worker.

sections.heading: Stop requests without terminating a borrowed Worker

blocks.text: A screen closes its RPC client while the application still owns the Worker and its port.
Terminating the Worker inside client cleanup destroys a resource owned elsewhere; only marking the client closed leaves its endpoint subscriptions installed.

Use close to reject new requests immediately, then await dispose to release the endpoint. Repeated dispose calls share one Promise; a native ping afterward checks that the borrowed Worker port still works.

`close()` and `dispose()` take no arguments. The former retires request admission synchronously; the latter releases the endpoint asynchronously and shares one Promise across calls. The native `'ping'` / `'pong'` exchange checks that the borrowed port still works; it is separate from this module's request protocol. This example created the port and Worker, so its `finally` block closes and terminates them.
Output:

blocks.code:
before close: 42
closed: true ADAPTER_DISPOSED
same cleanup: true
borrowed port: pong

blocks.text: The output is `before close: 42`, `closed: true ADAPTER_DISPOSED`, `same cleanup: true`, then `borrowed port: pong`.

close only changes admission; dispose performs asynchronous endpoint cleanup and can reject. Neither closes the native port nor terminates the Worker. The final ping is a separate native host message, not an RPC request.

sections.heading: Keep a Worker computation failure traceable

blocks.text: A Worker calculation throws a TypeError caused by an earlier RangeError, but the caller needs both failures to diagnose the input.
Sending only an error message loses native types, the nested cause and the original stack information across the thread boundary.

Wrap the real computation with createWorkerHandler and forward incoming messages to it. RPC returns a remote failure whose cause retains the native TypeError and its RangeError cause; no custom error-message protocol is needed.

Both functions passed to `createWorkerHandler(compute, postMessage)` are required. Here, compute throws a native `TypeError` with a cause, while postMessage delegates to the native port. No timeout is configured, so requests have no default deadline. Read the transferred cause chain rather than expecting object identity with the child-side error. The message listener observes delivery failures from the handler's Promise.
Output:

blocks.code:
remote: RpcRemoteError INTERNAL
primary: true cannot compute total
cause: true invalid row
stacks: true true

blocks.text: The output is `remote: RpcRemoteError INTERNAL`, `primary: true cannot compute total`, `cause: true invalid row`, then `stacks: true true`.

The outer error belongs to RPC Core; the native errors remain below cause rather than becoming the top-level TypeError. The message handler's Promise covers delivery, not compute completion; await the main-side request for the operation result.

sections.heading: Use Resource state and cache for Worker results

blocks.text: A view needs loading and successful states plus a cached Worker result, and its inputs can change later.
Keeping a separate result variable and cache beside Worker requests duplicates Resource behavior and makes it easy to show a result for outdated inputs.

Use workerComputed with a synchronous selector and the signal's Runtime. autoStart false skips eager construction work; reading state can still start lazy work. Await refetch, read the cached promise, then explicitly refresh after input changes.

`runtime` is explicitly the input signal's runtime; omission uses `defaultRuntime`. The selector synchronously returns `values.value`. `autoStart: false` overrides the default `true` only for eager construction; the first `state` read can still start work. `ttl` defaults to `Infinity` and is unchanged here. `refetch()` forces work, while passive `promise` reads can reuse fresh cache. Dispose the Resource before its borrowed adapter and native Worker.
Output:

blocks.code:
before: pending
first: 6 success
cache: true 6
next: 9 success

blocks.text: The output is `before: pending`, `first: 6 success`, `cache: true 6`, then `next: 9 success`.

autoStart defaults to true; false skips eager construction, not lazy state reads. The first state read starts work and reports pending. ttl defaults to Infinity; passive promise reads reuse fresh cache, while refetch forces work. Dispose Resource before its borrowed adapter and Worker.

blocks.text: An application already uses a serialization registry, but one parser should execute inside a Worker.

This module owns payload conversion, chunk credit / ACK, and the integration rather than another RPC engine.

Serializer input enters the transfer list only for bytes containing a genuine Uint8Array whose view spans one entire ordinary ArrayBuffer: offset zero and view length equal to backing length. Evaluate actual work instead of deriving speed from the presence of a Worker.

A compute failure commonly has RpcRemoteError / INTERNAL outside reconstructed native TypeError / RangeError causes with their messages and stacks. Without a deadline, a provider that never settles can leave a request pending; every broken Worker is not guaranteed to settle promptly.
